name: Predestined
overview: Scripture teaches that God sovereignly predestines believers to be conformed to the image of His Son and to adoption as His children, according to His own will and purpose (Romans 8:29; Ephesians 1:5, 1:11). This divine predestination is rooted in God's foreknowledge and is consistent with His loving initiative to draw individuals to Christ, ensuring their eternal life through faith (John 3:16; John 6:44). Thus, predestination reflects God's gracious plan to bring His people into a family relationship with Him and to secure their ultimate inheritance.
